words.en: A consultant is a person who gives expert advice to a person or organization on a particular subject.

words.ex: His answer was vague and hard to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答不明确，难以理解。
words.en: If something written or spoken is vague, it does not explain or express things clearly.

words.ex: He vaguely remembered the name.
words.ex_cn: 他模糊地记得这个名字。
words.en: If you describe something as vaguely, you mean that it is not clear, distinct, or definite.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text A - Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 倾向于做某事；乐意做某事
words.ex: He is disposed to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他愿意帮助他的朋友。
words.en: If you are disposed to do something, you are willing or eager to do it.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 在两方面都；两项指控都成立；两个理由都成立
words.ex: He failed on both counts.
words.ex_cn: 他在两个方面都失败了。
words.en: In both aspects or respects.

words.ex: He will take over the business next month.
words.ex_cn: 他下个月将接管这家企业。
words.en: To take control of something, especially a company, by buying a majority of its shares or by getting a position of power within it.

words.tr: phrase. 对某人放肆无礼；对某人行为轻率或越界
words.ex: He takes liberties with his boss by arriving late every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天迟到，对老板不拘礼节。
words.en: To behave in a way that is too free or not respectful enough towards someone, especially in a way that involves touching them without their permission.

words.tr: 短语动词. 与某人相处时感到自在、轻松
words.ex: He feels at ease with his new teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他和新老师在一起时感到轻松。
words.en: To feel comfortable and relaxed in someone's company.

words.tr: phrase. 向…作出让步；对…妥协
words.ex: He made a concession to his sister by letting her choose the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他向妹妹让步，让她选择了电影。
words.en: To yield or agree to a demand or request, often in a negotiation.

words.tr: phrase. 向…作出让步；对…妥协
words.ex: In order to reach an agreement, both parties had to make concessions to each other.
words.ex_cn: 为了达成协议，双方不得不互相做出让步。
words.en: To make concessions to someone means to agree to give them something or to allow them to do something, especially in order to end an argument or conflict.

words.ex: To some extent, he likes the new job.
words.ex_cn: 在某种程度上，他喜欢这份新工作。
words.en: To some extent means to a certain degree or in a certain measure, but not completely.

words.tr: phrase. 可归结为；屈尊做某事
words.ex: It will come down to who works harder.
words.ex_cn: 这将取决于谁更努力。
words.en: If a problem, decision, or question comes down to a particular thing, that thing is the most important factor involved.

words.ex: The thieves burst into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 小偷在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: If you burst into a particular kind of activity, you suddenly start doing it.

words.tr: phrase. 对……表示反对；对……反感；对……提出异议
words.ex: He takes exception to people who are late.
words.ex_cn: 他看不惯迟到的人。
words.en: To object strongly to something; to be offended by something.

words.ex: His love of music stems from his childhood.
words.ex_cn: 他对音乐的热爱源于他的童年。
words.en: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text B - New words

words.tr: adj. 家庭的；国内的；驯养的；
words.ex: She prefers domestic chores over going out.
words.ex_cn: 她更喜欢做家务而不是外出。
words.en: Domestic means relating to the home, family, or household affairs. It can also refer to something that is made or produced within a country and not imported.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人作呕的； v. “disgust”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of the rotten food was disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂食物的气味令人厌恶。
words.en: If you say that something is disgusting, you mean that you find it completely unacceptable or unpleasant.

words.ex: The public condemned the corrupt politician.
words.ex_cn: 公众谴责了这位腐败的政客。
words.en: If you condemn something, you say that it is very bad and unacceptable.

words.ex: The duration of the movie is two hours.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的持续时间是两小时。
words.en: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

words.ex: The baby is crawling on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 婴儿正在地板上爬。
words.en: To move slowly on hands and knees or by dragging the body close to the ground.

words.ex: He checks the calendar every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都看日历。
words.en: A calendar is a chart or device which displays the date and the day of the week, and often the whole of a particular year divided up into months, weeks, and days.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.tr: n. 城河；壕坑; n. （Foss）人名；（德、英、法、西、瑞典）福斯
words.ex: The castle is surrounded by a deep foss.
words.ex_cn: 城堡被一条深城河环绕。
words.en: A fossilized remnant or trace of an organism from a past geological age.

words.tr:
n. 化合物；
adj. 复合的；混合的；
words.ex: Water is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.
words.ex_cn: 水是由氢和氧组成的化合物。
words.en: A compound is a substance that consists of two or more elements chemically combined in fixed proportions.

words.ex: He listened to his conscience and told the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他听从了良心，说出了真相。
words.en: Your conscience is the part of your mind that tells you whether what you are doing is right or wrong.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.tr: adj. 有皱纹的；皱皱巴巴的； v. “wrinkle”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: The old man had wrinkled hands.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人的手有皱纹。
words.en: Having wrinkles or creases; not smooth.

words.ex: He grinds the coffee beans into powder.
words.ex_cn: 他把咖啡豆碾成粉末。
words.en: To reduce something to small particles or powder by crushing it.

words.tr:
v. 打呵欠
n. 呵欠
words.ex: He yawned during the boring lecture.
words.ex_cn: 他在无聊的讲座上打哈欠。
words.en: If you yawn, you open your mouth very wide and breathe in more air than usual, often because you are tired or bored.

words.ex: He is receiving therapy for his back pain.
words.ex_cn: 他正在接受治疗以缓解背痛。
words.en: Therapy is the treatment of someone with mental or physical illness without the use of drugs or operations.

words.ex: The glass broke into small fragments.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃碎成了小碎片。
words.en: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

words.ex: He noticed every detail of the painting.
words.ex_cn: 他注意到了这幅画的每一个细节。
words.en: A detail is a small individual feature or element of something.

words.tr:
adj. 联合的；共同的；
n. 关节；接合处；
words.ex: They signed a joint agreement to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一项联合协议来保护环境。
words.en: A joint is a place where two things are joined together, especially the place where two bones are connected in a person's or animal's body.

words.ex: He converts old paper into new notebooks.
words.ex_cn: 他把旧纸张转换成新笔记本。
words.en: To change something into a different form or to change someone's beliefs, especially their religious beliefs.

words.ex: The team comprises five players and one coach.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队包括五名球员和一名教练。
words.en: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.

words.tr:
n. 真空；空虚；
v. 用真空吸尘器打扫；
words.ex: The vacuum in space keeps no air.
words.ex_cn: 太空中的真空没有空气。
words.en: A vacuum is a space that contains no air or other gas, or a space from which most of the air or gas has been removed. It can also refer to a device that cleans floors and surfaces by sucking up dirt and dust.

words.tr:
n. 内部；
adj. 内部的；
words.ex: The interior of the house is very cozy.
words.ex_cn: 房子的内部非常舒适。
words.en: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

words.ex: The children play on the lawn after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在草坪上玩耍。
words.en: A lawn is an area of grass that is kept cut short and is usually part of someone's garden or yard, or part of a park.

words.ex: He wants to study journalism after high school.
words.ex_cn: 他想在高中后学习新闻工作。
words.en: The profession or practice of reporting about, photographing, or editing news stories for one of the mass media.

words.ex: The boy resembles his father.
words.ex_cn: 这个男孩长得像他父亲。
words.en: If one thing or person resembles another, they are similar to each other.

words.ex: He added an ounce of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: An ounce is a unit of weight used in Britain and the USA. There are sixteen ounces in a pound.

words.ex: She put the cake in the oven.
words.ex_cn: 她把蛋糕放进烤箱里。
words.en: An oven is a device for cooking food, using dry heat.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: He sat on the couch and watched TV.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在沙发上看电视。
words.en: A couch is a long, comfortable seat for two or more people to sit on. It is also used to refer to a piece of furniture designed for lying down or sleeping.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.ex: He votes in a democratic election.
words.ex_cn: 他在民主选举中投票。
words.en: A democratic country, government, or political system is governed by representatives who are elected by the people.

words.tr: adv. 民主地；民主主义地
words.ex: They voted democratically to choose their leader.
words.ex_cn: 他们通过民主投票选出了自己的领袖。
words.en: In a way that is related to or supporting democracy; in a democratic manner.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.ex: I can't tolerate loud noises.
words.ex_cn: 我无法容忍巨大的噪音。
words.en: If you tolerate a situation or person, you accept them although you do not particularly like them.

words.tr: n. 事件；一集；一段经历；
words.ex: The accident was a sad episode in his life.
words.ex_cn: 那场事故是他生命中的一件悲伤的事。
words.en: An episode is a part of a story that is broadcast on television or radio as one of a series, or a single event or group of related events.

words.tr:
adj. 周期的；定期的
n. 期刊
words.ex: The plant has a periodical blooming cycle.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物有周期性的开花周期。
words.en: A periodical is a magazine, especially one that is published regularly, or something that happens at regular intervals.

words.tr:
v. 补充；
n. 补充物；附加费；
words.ex: He supplements his income by teaching part-time.
words.ex_cn: 他通过兼职教学来补充收入。
words.en: A supplement is something that is added to something else in order to make it complete or better.

words.tr:
adv. 在海外；在国外；
adj. 海外的；
words.ex: He moved overseas for work.
words.ex_cn: 他为了工作搬到了海外。
words.en: If something is overseas, it is in a foreign country, usually separated from your own country by an ocean.

words.ex: He exerted pressure on his team to win.
words.ex_cn: 他给他的团队施加了压力以赢得比赛。
words.en: To exert means to use power, influence, or effort to make something happen.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.ex: The king oppresses the poor people.
words.ex_cn: 国王压迫穷人。
words.en: If someone oppresses people, they treat them cruelly or unfairly and prevent them from having the same rights as other people.

words.tr:
v. 叛乱；反叛；（使）厌恶
n. 叛乱；厌恶；反感
words.ex: The people revolt against the unfair rules.
words.ex_cn: 人们反抗不公平的规则。
words.en: If a large number of people revolt, they refuse to be controlled or ruled, and take action against authority, often violent action.

words.tr: v. 设置；放；“set”的现在分词； n. 环境；背景；
words.ex: He is setting the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他正在把闹钟设置为早上6点。
words.en: The context and environment in which something is set or takes place.

words.ex: He swore he didn't steal the money.
words.ex_cn: 他发誓他没有偷钱。
words.en: If someone swears, they use language that is considered to be rude or offensive, usually because they are angry.

words.ex: He kept his dignity even when he was poor.
words.ex_cn: 即使他很穷，他依然保持尊严。
words.en: Dignity is the quality of being worthy of honor or respect.

chapters.name: Unit 7 Text B - Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使变热；加热；使变得更激烈
words.ex: The sun will heat up the sand.
words.ex_cn: 太阳会让沙子变热。
words.en: To make something hot or warm.

words.tr: phrase. v. 忙于做某事；专心致志于
words.ex: He is busy himself with cleaning the room.
words.ex_cn: 他正忙于打扫房间。
words.en: To occupy oneself with a particular activity or task; to keep oneself busy.

words.tr: phrase. 爬上床；钻进被窝（通常指因疲惫或寒冷而缓慢、费力地躺下休息）
words.ex: After a long day at work, all I want to do is crawl into bed.
words.ex_cn: v. 工作了一整天后，我只想爬上床。
words.en: To get into bed, especially when very tired or after a long day.

words.tr: 短语动词. 费力地从床上爬起来，通常形容因疲惫或不情愿而缓慢艰难地起床
words.ex: He can hardly crawl out of bed in the morning because he is so tired.
words.ex_cn: 他早上几乎无法从床上爬起来，因为他太累了。
words.en: To get out of bed slowly and with difficulty, often because one is tired or ill.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.tr: phrase. v. 对……过分关心或小题大做；为……忙乱
words.ex: My mom always fusses over my little sister when she is sick.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈总是在我妹妹生病时对她大惊小怪。
words.en: To give too much attention to small, unimportant details, or to someone, in a way that shows you are worried or nervous.

words.tr: phrase. 凭良心无法（做某事）；实在不能；于心不安
words.ex: I couldn't charge you that much not in all conscience.
words.ex_cn: 我无论如何也不能收你那么多钱。
words.en: If you say that you cannot do something in all conscience, you mean that you cannot do it because you think it is wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 凭良心无法；问心有愧地；不能心安理得地
words.ex: I couldn't do that to him, not in good conscience.
words.ex_cn: 我不能那样对他，良心上过不去。
words.en: If you say that you cannot do something in good conscience, you mean that you cannot do it because you think it is wrong.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人视为；认为某人是
words.ex: I always think of him as a reliable friend.
words.ex_cn: 我总是认为他是一个可靠的朋友。
words.en: To regard someone in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 把某物视为；认为某物是
words.ex: He thinks of himself as a great artist.
words.ex_cn: 他认为自己是一个伟大的艺术家。
words.en: To consider something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 由……组成；包含（通常应为 'comprise' 而非 'be comprised of'，此用法存在争议）
words.ex: The team is comprised of five players.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队由五名队员组成。
words.en: To be made up of or consist of certain elements or parts.

words.tr: 短语，表示"一点点，少许（通常指某种品质或东西）"，常用于强调即使是很小的量也有价值，如：an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure（预防胜于治疗）
words.ex: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
words.ex_cn: 预防胜于治疗。
words.en: A very small amount of something, used to emphasize a tiny quantity.

words.ex: This painting is unique because no other like it exists.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是独特的，因为没有其他类似的。
words.en: Something that is unique is the only one of its kind.

words.tr:
n. 代用品；代替物；
v. 替代；
words.ex: Honey is a good substitute for sugar.
words.ex_cn: 蜂蜜是糖的良好代用品。
words.en: A substitute is something or someone that takes the place or function of another.

words.tr: phrase. 击掌庆祝；与某人击掌表示庆祝或鼓励
words.ex: After scoring the winning goal, he ran to his teammates to give them five.
words.ex_cn: 在踢进制胜一球后，他跑向队友与他们击掌庆祝。
words.en: To slap palms with someone as a gesture of greeting, celebration, or agreement.

words.tr: 短语动词. 和某人击掌庆祝
words.ex: After scoring the winning goal, he ran to his teammates to give them a five.
words.ex_cn: 在进球得分后，他跑向队友与他们击掌庆祝。
words.en: To give someone a high-five, a celebratory hand slap.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A - New words

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: The rumor spread quickly that the school would close.
words.ex_cn: 学校即将关闭的谣言迅速传播开来。
words.en: A rumor is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.ex: She tied the box with a thin string.
words.ex_cn: 她用一根细线把盒子绑了起来。
words.en: A string is a thin piece of rope or cord, or a series of things connected together.

words.tr:
adj. 恶毒的；
n. 邪恶；罪恶；
words.ex: The evil king punished innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 这个恶毒的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Evil is a powerful force that some people believe to exist, and which causes wicked and bad things to happen.

words.ex: The supreme leader makes the final decision.
words.ex_cn: 至上的领导人做出最终决定。
words.en: If you say that something is supreme, you mean that it is the most important or the best of its kind.

words.tr: n. 居住；定居；驻留期；住院医生实习期
words.ex: He completed his residency in New York.
words.ex_cn: 他在纽约完成了居住。
words.en: Residency refers to the state of living in a particular place or the period of advanced medical training and education that a physician undergoes in a hospital or clinic, usually after completing medical school.

words.tr: n. 流血；杀戮；流血事件
words.ex: The war caused much bloodshed.
words.ex_cn: 这场战争造成了大量流血。
words.en: Bloodshed is the killing or wounding of people, usually during fighting or a war.

words.tr: adj. 外科的；外科手术的；
words.ex: The surgical team worked quickly to save the patient.
words.ex_cn: 外科团队迅速工作以挽救病人。
words.en: Relating to or used in surgery.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.tr:
v. 移栽；移植；
n. 移植；
words.ex: He will transplant the flowers to the garden tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天要把这些花移栽到花园里。
words.en: To transplant something means to move it from one place to another. In medicine, to transplant an organ, piece of skin, etc. means to use it to replace a damaged part in someone's body.

words.ex: The hospital performed a kidney transplantation last week.
words.ex_cn: 医院上周进行了肾脏移植手术。
words.en: The act or process of moving an organ, tissue, or living thing from one place or person to another.

words.tr:
n. 规模；等级；比例（尺）；刻度；秤；
v. 改变…大小；
words.ex: The scale of the project surprised everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目的规模让所有人都感到惊讶。
words.en: A scale is a set of levels or numbers which are used in a particular system of measuring things or are used when comparing things.

words.ex: He gave the rope a twist to tie it tight.
words.ex_cn: 他把绳子拧了一下以便系紧。
words.en: To twist something means to turn it in a different direction or to change its shape by turning it.

words.tr:
n. 寓言；神话传说；无稽之谈
v. 虚构
words.ex: The old man told a fable about a fox and a crow.
words.ex_cn: 老人讲了一个关于狐狸和乌鸦的寓言。
words.en: A fable is a short story that typically features animals as characters and conveys a moral lesson.

words.ex: The devil made him do it.
words.ex_cn: 魔鬼让他这么做的。
words.en: In Christian theology, the devil is the supreme spirit of evil, often represented as the tempter of humankind and the enemy of God and goodness.

words.ex: He used a compass to find north.
words.ex_cn: 他用指南针找北方。
words.en: A compass is an instrument that you use for finding directions. It has a dial and a magnetic needle that always points to the north.

words.ex: The senator speaks to the people every week.
words.ex_cn: 这位参议员每周都对人民讲话。
words.en: A senator is a member of a senate, which is a governing body in many countries, especially in the United States.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.ex: The cat creeps slowly toward the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹑手蹑脚地向鸟靠近。
words.en: To move slowly and quietly, especially in a way that does not attract attention.

words.ex: He felt hatred for the man who hurt his brother.
words.ex_cn: 他憎恨那个伤害他兄弟的人。
words.en: Hatred is an extremely strong feeling of dislike for someone or something.

words.ex: He asked for her consent before starting the project.
words.ex_cn: 他在开始这个项目之前征求了她的同意。
words.en: Consent is permission for something to happen or agreement to do something.

words.ex: The company used a short slogan to attract customers.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司用了一个简短的口号来吸引顾客。
words.en: A short and striking or memorable phrase used in advertising or politics.

words.ex: The external wall of the house is painted blue.
words.ex_cn: 房子的外墙被刷成了蓝色。
words.en: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

words.ex: People discuss politics on this forum.
words.ex_cn: 人们在这个论坛上讨论政治。
words.en: A forum is a place, situation, or group in which people exchange ideas and discuss issues, especially important public issues.

words.ex: The volume of the box is 10 cubic meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的体积是10立方米。
words.en: A volume is a book, especially one that is part of a series of books. It can also refer to the amount of space that a substance or object occupies, or the level of sound produced by a television, radio, etc.

words.ex: He flung his hat on the chair.
words.ex_cn: 他把帽子扔在椅子上。
words.en: To throw something quickly and carelessly; to move or do something suddenly and energetically.

words.ex: Washing hands can kill germs.
words.ex_cn: 洗手可以杀死病菌。
words.en: A germ is a very small organism that causes disease.

words.tr:
n. 一群；一帮；一伙
v. 成群结队；结成一伙；合伙攻击
words.ex: The gang stole a car last night.
words.ex_cn: 那群人昨晚偷了一辆车。
words.en: A gang is a group of people, especially young people, who go around together and often deliberately cause trouble.

words.ex: The stars seem eternal in the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 夜空中的星星看起来是永久的。
words.en: If something is eternal, it lasts forever.

words.tr: adj. 可选择的；非强制的；
words.ex: The field trip is optional.
words.ex_cn: 这次郊游是可选的。
words.en: If something is optional, you can choose whether or not you do it or have it.

words.ex: He omitted the last word in the sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他省略了句子中的最后一个词。
words.en: If you omit something, you do not include it in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.ex: The police arrested the thief last night.
words.ex_cn: 警察昨晚逮捕了那个小偷。
words.en: If the police arrest you, they take charge of you and take you to a police station, because they believe you may have committed a crime.

words.ex: The wound caused a serious infection.
words.ex_cn: 伤口引起了严重的感染。
words.en: An infection is a disease caused by microorganisms such as bacteria, viruses, or parasites invading the body.

words.ex: The doctor can diagnose the illness quickly.
words.ex_cn: 医生能很快诊断出这种病。
words.en: If someone or something is diagnosed as having a particular illness or problem, their illness or problem is identified. If an illness or problem is diagnosed, it is identified.

words.ex: The doctor used a diagnostic test to find the problem.
words.ex_cn: 医生使用了一项诊断测试来找出问题。
words.en: Relating to the identification of the nature and cause of a phenomenon, especially a disease or other disorder.

words.ex: The resolution of the conflict took many meetings.
words.ex_cn: 这个冲突的解决花了多次会议。
words.en: A resolution is a formal decision made at a meeting by the vote of the people who are there. It can also refer to a firm decision to do or not to do something.

words.tr: adj. 不赏识的，不欣赏的
words.ex: She was unappreciative of all the hard work he had put in.
words.ex_cn: 她对他所付出的所有努力都不赏识。
words.en: If you are unappreciative, you do not recognize or value the worth or quality of something or someone.

words.tr:
v. 防止；战斗；抑制；
n. 战斗；
words.ex: The new law aims to combat pollution.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法律旨在防止污染。
words.en: Combat refers to fighting, especially during a war. It can also mean to try to stop something harmful from happening or increasing.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his hip.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤到了臀部。
words.en: The hip is the area on each side of the body below the waist and above the thigh.

words.ex: He needs surgery for his broken arm.
words.ex_cn: 他需要做手术来治疗断掉的胳膊。
words.en: Surgery is the medical specialty that uses operative manual and instrumental techniques on a patient to investigate or treat a pathological condition such as a disease or injury, to help improve bodily function or appearance, or to repair unwanted ruptured areas.

words.tr: adj. 有缺点的；有缺陷的；有毛病的；
words.ex: The defective phone wouldn't turn on.
words.ex_cn: 这部有缺点的手机无法开机。
words.en: If something is defective, there is something wrong with it and it does not work properly.

words.ex: He has a gene that makes him tall.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个让他长高的基因。
words.en: A gene is the basic physical and functional unit of heredity. Genes, which are made up of DNA, act as instructions to make molecules called proteins.

words.ex: The shirt is made of synthetic fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫是合成纤维制成的。
words.en: Synthetic products are made from chemicals or artificial substances rather than from natural ones.

words.ex: The universe may be infinite.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙可能是无限的。
words.en: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我等了五分钟。
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.ex: The creature lived in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这个生物生活在森林里。
words.en: A creature is a living thing, especially an animal.

words.ex: It rained all day, hence the game was canceled.
words.ex_cn: 下了一整天的雨，因此比赛被取消了。
words.en: You use hence to indicate that the statement you are about to make is a consequence of what you have just said.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text A - Phrases and expressions

words.tr: phrase. 使天平倾斜；使形势偏向一方；起决定性作用
words.ex: Even a small amount of extra weight can tip the scales.
words.ex_cn: 即使多一点点重量也能使天平倾斜。
words.en: If something tips the scales or tips the balance, it gives someone a slight advantage.

words.tr: phrase. 选派某人扮演（某个角色）
words.ex: The director cast her as the lead actress in the play.
words.ex_cn: 导演选她在这部剧中扮演女主角。
words.en: To choose someone to play a particular role in a film, play, etc.

words.ex: This rule has relevance to all students.
words.ex_cn: 这个规则与所有学生都有关。
words.en: To be connected with or applicable to a particular subject or issue.

words.tr: phrase. （不良现象）逐渐产生，悄悄蔓延，潜入
words.ex: He tried to creep in unnoticed.
words.ex_cn: 他试图悄悄地混进去而不被察觉。
words.en: To enter or appear gradually or stealthily.

words.ex: He will persist in trying to learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 他会坚持每天努力学习英语。
words.en: To continue to do something despite difficulties or opposition, in a way that can seem unreasonable.

words.tr: phrase. 重视；充分利用；大肆渲染；对…表示赞赏；疼爱
words.ex: He didn't make much of the mistake at first.
words.ex_cn: 他一开始并没有太在意这个错误。
words.en: To treat something as very important; to use something to the greatest possible advantage.

words.ex: He acted in the name of justice.
words.ex_cn: 他以正义的名义行动。
words.en: If you do something in the name of a particular cause or principle, you do it in order to support that cause or principle.

words.tr: phrase. phr. 为某人辩护；为某人辩解；在某人看来
words.ex: He said it to help, so I will say this in his defense.
words.ex_cn: 他说这话是想帮忙，所以我要为他说句话。
words.en: Used to say that there are good reasons why someone did something, especially when other people are criticizing them.

words.ex_cn: 他正忙于做作业。
words.en: To be busy with a particular activity or task.

words.tr: phrase. 正在考虑；正被谈论的；讨论中的；可怀疑
words.ex: The job in question is still available.
words.ex_cn: 正在讨论的工作仍然空缺。
words.en: The person, thing, or group that is in question is the one that you have been talking about or that is involved in the situation you are discussing.

words.tr: phrase. 与……一样；正如……的情况
words.ex: As is the case with most startups, they faced many challenges in the beginning.
words.ex_cn: 正如大多数初创公司的情况一样，他们在开始时面临了许多挑战。
words.en: used to say that something is true about the person or thing that you have just mentioned

words.ex: The hospital will isolate the patient to stop the spread.
words.ex_cn: 医院将隔离这名病人以防止传播。
words.en: To isolate someone or something means to separate them from other people or things, often in order to protect them or to prevent the spread of something harmful.

words.ex: He wants to make a contribution to the school library.
words.ex_cn: 他想为学校图书馆做点贡献。
words.en: To give or supply in common with others; give to a common fund or for a common purpose.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: He became aware of his mistake after he checked the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在检查论文后意识到了自己的错误。
words.en: To come to know or realize something.

words.tr: phrase. 意识到；察觉到；知道
words.ex: Be aware of the danger near the river.
words.ex_cn: 注意河边的危险。
words.en: To have knowledge or understanding of something.

words.ex: Hard work can bring about success.
words.ex_cn: 努力工作可以带来成功。
words.en: To cause something to happen.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text B - New words

words.ex: The puppy is playing with a ball.
words.ex_cn: 小狗在玩球。
words.en: A puppy is a young dog.

words.ex: He sat on the rug near the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在壁炉旁的地毯上。
words.en: A rug is a piece of thick material that you put on the floor to cover part of it and to make it warmer or softer to walk on.

words.ex: He rubs his hands together to warm them.
words.ex_cn: 他搓手来暖和它们。
words.en: To move one's hand or a cloth repeatedly back and forth on the surface of something with firm pressure.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.ex: The royal family lives in a big palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇室住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royal is used to describe something that is connected with a king, queen, or emperor, or with their family. It can also describe something that is splendid or magnificent, befitting a king or queen.

words.ex: The wheel rotates slowly.
words.ex_cn: 轮子缓慢地转动。
words.en: To rotate means to turn or cause to turn around an axis or center.

words.ex: The rhythm of the music made everyone dance.
words.ex_cn: 音乐的节奏让所有人都跳起了舞。
words.en: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

words.tr:
n. 滞后；延迟；
v. 落后；缓慢移动；
words.ex: There is a lag between the signal and the response.
words.ex_cn: 信号和响应之间有滞后。
words.en: If one thing or person lags behind another thing or person, their progress is slower than that of the other.

words.tr:
n. 跳跃；
v. 跳跃；
words.ex: The cat made a big leap over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 猫跳过了篱笆。
words.en: To leap means to jump high or a long way, or to move quickly and with a lot of energy.

words.ex: Fish reproduce in the river.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在河里繁殖。
words.en: To produce something again; to make a copy of something.

words.tr:
n. 脚趾
v. 用脚尖触
words.ex: He touched the ball with his toe.
words.ex_cn: 他用脚趾碰了球。
words.en: One of the five digits at the end of the foot, or the similar part of a shoe or sock.

words.ex: He shoved his way through the crowd.
words.ex_cn: 他挤过人群。
words.en: To push someone or something in a rough or careless way.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.ex: He squeezed into the small seat.
words.ex_cn: 他挤进了小座位里。
words.en: To squeeze something means to press it firmly, usually with your fingers or hands, often to get liquid out of it or to make it smaller.

words.ex: He strengthened his muscle by lifting weights.
words.ex_cn: 他通过举重来增强肌肉。
words.en: Muscle is the tissue in the body that can contract to produce movement or maintain the position of parts of the body.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: He sneaked out of the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上偷偷溜出了房子。
words.en: To move quietly and secretly in order to avoid being noticed.

words.ex: He deducts tax from his salary every month.
words.ex_cn: 他每月从工资中扣除税款。
words.en: If you deduct an amount from a total, you subtract it from the total.

words.ex: Telecommunications connect people across the world.
words.ex_cn: 电信连接了全世界的人们。
words.en: Telecommunications is the technology of sending signals and messages over long distances using electronic means, such as radio, telephone, television, and the internet.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: They live in a quiet suburb outside the city.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在城市外一个安静的市郊。
words.en: A suburb is a residential district located on the outskirts of a city.

words.tr: n. 一个特殊日子的前夕或前夜
words.ex: The eve of Christmas is very special.
words.ex_cn: 圣诞节前夜非常特别。
words.en: The period of time immediately before an event or occasion, especially the day before a holiday or festival.

words.ex: The internal parts of the machine need repair.
words.ex_cn: 机器的内部零件需要修理。
words.en: Internal is used to describe things that exist or happen inside a particular person, object, or place.

words.ex: The jury decided the man was innocent.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团裁定这个人无罪。
words.en: A jury is a group of people who are chosen to decide whether someone is guilty or not guilty of a crime in a court of law.

words.ex: He drives a red van to work.
words.ex_cn: 他开一辆红色的货车去上班。
words.en: A van is a road vehicle used for transporting goods or people, usually larger than a car but smaller than a truck.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.tr:
int. 喂；哈喽；
n. “喂”的招呼声或问候声；
words.ex: Hello, can you hear me?
words.ex_cn: 喂，你能听到我吗？
words.en: used as a greeting or to begin a telephone conversation

words.tr:
v. 放电；放出；
n. 排放；
words.ex: The battery will discharge if left unused for a long time.
words.ex_cn: 如果长时间不使用，电池会放电。
words.en: If someone is discharged from a hospital, prison, or the armed forces, they are officially allowed to leave, or told that they must leave. If something is discharged from inside a place, it comes out.

words.tr: n. 生物体；有机体；有机组织；
words.ex: A bacterium is a simple organism.
words.ex_cn: 细菌是一种简单的生物体。
words.en: An organism is a living thing that has an organized structure, can react to stimuli, reproduce, grow, adapt, and maintain homeostasis.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.tr: adj. 注意的；专心的；留心的；关心的
words.ex: The child is attentive in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子上课很专心。
words.en: If you are attentive, you are paying close attention to what is being said or done.

words.ex: The village suffered from famine last year.
words.ex_cn: 去年这个村庄遭受了饥荒。
words.en: A famine is a serious shortage of food in a country, which may cause many people to get sick or die.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.ex: She bought a beautiful china cup at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买了一个漂亮的瓷杯。
words.en: China is a country in East Asia, the world's most populous country, with a population of over 1.4 billion. It is also known for its rich history, culture, and contributions to the world, including the invention of paper, printing, the compass, and gunpowder.

words.ex: The kids are watching the countdown to New Year.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们正在观看新年的倒计时。
words.en: A countdown is the counting aloud of numbers in reverse order before something happens, especially before a spacecraft is launched.

words.ex: The boy walked down the long corridor.
words.ex_cn: 男孩走过了长长的走廊。
words.en: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

words.ex: The boy hurt his spine when he fell from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 他从树上摔下来时伤到了脊柱。
words.en: The spine is the row of bones down the center of your back that supports your body and protects your spinal cord.

words.tr:
v. 点击；
n. 咔哒声；
words.ex: Click the button to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 点击按钮开始游戏。
words.en: To make a short, sharp sound, or to press a button on a computer mouse or other device to select something on a screen.

words.ex: The doctor checked the vein in his arm.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了他手臂上的静脉。
words.en: A vein is a tube in your body that carries blood towards your heart. It can also refer to a thin layer of a mineral in rock, or a particular style or mood in writing or speech.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an injection for the pain.
words.ex_cn: 医生给他打了一针来缓解疼痛。
words.en: An injection is the act of putting a liquid, especially a drug, into a person's body using a needle and a syringe.

words.ex: The lamp emits a soft light.
words.ex_cn: 灯发出柔和的光。
words.en: To emit means to send out something such as light, heat, sound, gas, etc.

words.ex: The teacher gave a cue to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了开始游戏的提示。
words.en: A cue is a signal for someone to do something, or a piece of information that helps someone to understand something.

words.ex: The sun wakens the birds every morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳每天早晨唤醒鸟儿。
words.en: to stop sleeping or to make someone stop sleeping

words.ex: A fraction of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 只有一小部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: A fraction is a small part or amount of something.

chapters.name: Unit 8 Text B - Phrases and expressions

words.ex: He will not give in to the bully.
words.ex_cn: 他不会向欺凌者屈服。
words.en: To agree to something that you had been opposing, especially because someone has forced or persuaded you to.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人翻过来；使某人翻身
words.ex: He gently rolled the baby over to change her diaper.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻地把婴儿翻过来换尿布。
words.en: To turn someone onto their back, often in a physical confrontation or to search them.

words.ex: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: To supply or make available to someone something that is needed or wanted.

words.ex: Tom often lags behind in class because he doesn't study.
words.ex_cn: 汤姆因为不学习，经常在课堂上落后。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others or to fall behind in progress, development, or achievement.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.tr: phrase. 从某物中扣除某物；减去
words.ex: The cost of the damaged goods will be deducted from your payment.
words.ex_cn: 损坏商品的费用将从您的付款中扣除。
words.en: If you deduct an amount from a total, you subtract it from the total.

words.tr: phrase. 在……的前夕；临近……的时候
words.ex: On the eve of the election, the candidates were making their final speeches.
words.ex_cn: 在选举的前夜，候选人们正在进行最后的演讲。
words.en: Just before an important event or occasion.

words.ex: The soup has a smell of garlic.
words.ex_cn: 这汤有大蒜的味道。
words.en: To have a particular smell that is caused by something.

words.ex: Please fill out this form before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在离开前填写这张表格。
words.en: To complete a form or document by providing the required information.
